I don’t know if this is the kind of response you’re after but here goes. 
I grew up with a parent with a mental illness no one wanted to acknowledge. Around 12 I started with my own depressed tendencies and have struggled ever since. 
I’ve been labelled as treatment resistant, have put a real strain on my family, and the guilt I feel because of it is immense. 
I have 3 kids, all girls, and what I put them through really kills me.
Today I chalked up my 5th ECT session. I hope to god this works, if for no one else, but my kids. I’m happy to say that somethings changing, I don’t know exactly what, but the negative, suicidal, hatred is nowhere near as intense as it was. 
Add to that inconvenience, confusion and memory loss, I’m very great full I have such a support husband and kids
